name: triage
context_rationale: Interactive: asks mode/risk questions one at a time and engages with each answer, picks mode collaboratively, and writes project-open artifacts. Needs the live user conversation, so it cannot be delegated to a fresh-context subagent.
summary: Greenfield AI SDLC project opener. Picks the pipeline mode (Minimal / Standard / Heavy) via interactive Q&A (or accepts a pre-declared mode), builds the initial reversibility-tagged risk register, writes the thin vault skeleton (triage.json, risk-register.json, decisions/, spikes/, slices/) plus a small project-root CLAUDE.md, optionally installs code-review-graph integration, and tells the user the mode-specific next step. Re-runnable for mid-project re-scoping. Greenfield only — routes substantial existing codebases to /adopt.

reads.purpose: Re-triage detection (Step 1) — read existing mode + risks to update rather than overwrite.
Step 5b — read to decide fresh-create vs append.

outputs.purpose: Triage snapshot: mode, classification, rationale, pipeline path, deferred steps, initial risk snapshot.
Running risk ledger, one RR-1 block per risk; validated by risk_register_audit.
Heavy mode only — empty comprehensive-vault dirs pre-created for compliance (components/contracts/actors/test-plan/frontend/schemas).
Project-root pipeline-enforcement file (created fresh or appended). STAYS MARKDOWN in v2 — Claude Code reads it natively.

outputs.path: code-review-graph integration (MCP tools + git hooks + .code-review-graph/ store)
outputs.purpose: Step 5b-pre, opt-in. Installs the always-on code-review-graph integration.

tools.name: risk_register_audit
tools.purpose: Validates the risk register written in Step 5 (required fields, valid values, scoring/sorting per RR-1).

tools.name: code-review-graph
tools.purpose: Code graph via code-review-graph (CRG) — installs the Claude Code MCP integration (30 MCP tools + slash commands + git hooks); builds/refreshes the code graph. Replaces graphify; vault-graph & multimodal-ingest uses dropped.
tools.note: External pip package (github.com/tirth8205/code-review-graph), MCP-native; graph stored in .code-review-graph/. Replaces graphify.

harness_tools.name: AskUserQuestion
harness_tools.purpose: Load-bearing — structured-options Q&A for mode selection, risk questions, and the code-review-graph-install / git-init prompts.

harness_tools.name: Read
harness_tools.purpose: Re-triage detection (read existing triage.json), reading existing CLAUDE.md before append.

harness_tools.name: Write
harness_tools.purpose: Write triage.json, risk-register.json, vault skeleton dirs, project-root CLAUDE.md.

harness_tools.name: Bash
harness_tools.purpose: Step 0 preflight detection and the optional code-review-graph install commands.
